description: This file defines a custom assertion class for testing DittoRuntimeException objects, providing various chainable assertion methods for properties of these exceptions.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for DittoRuntimeException objects with chainable methods to verify specific properties.

methods.name: DittoRuntimeAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion object with the actual DittoRuntimeException instance.

methods.name: hasErrorCode
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified error code.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified HttpStatusCode.

methods.name: hasStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified integer status code value.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasDescription
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified description.

methods.name: hasMessage
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified message.

methods.name: hasCause
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified cause.

methods.name: hasHref
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception has the specified href URI.

methods.name: hasNoHref
methods.description: Asserts that the actual exception does not have an href URI.
